content: Jesu Orot Matan Fim Iyawas
Orot matan fim auman tufuw ma’am Jesu remor inan itin.
Ana bai’ufununayah Jesu hibatiy, “Bai’obaiyenayan, yait ana kakafinamaim iwa’an iti orot matan fim auman tufuw? I taiyuwin ana kakafin o i hinah tamat hai kakafinamaim?”
Jesu eo, “Orot matan fim i men anabowabow kakafinamaim iwa’an matan ifimemih o i hinah tamah hai kakafinamaim, baise i ana fimemaim God ana fair iti orot biyanamaim nirerereb hina’itin.
Iti ana veya’amaim yait ayu iyunu anan i ana bowabow tanabow, gugumin i enan men karam yait ta nabow.
Ayu boun iti tafaramamaim ama’am, ayu i tafaram ana marakaw.”
Iti tur eo ufunamaim, Jesu kwei me yan re naatu iyuriyur bai bora’ah orot matan idadawir.
Naatu iu, “Kwen harew Siloam kukuf (nati wab anayabin iyafar) imaim kururub.” Imih orot in rurub naatu matan nuw sawar itah auman matabir au bar in.
Orot tain tuwan naatu sabuw afa marasika hi’i’itin ma fefefeyan, hibatiy, “Iti orot ta’imon mar etei ema efefefeyanaban i iti?”
Sabuw afa hi’o, “Orot i nati.” Afa hi’o, “En nati i ana yumatabe.” Baise orot taiyuwin eo, “Nati orot i ayu.”
Sabuw hibatiy, “Mi’itube o mat igewasin kunuwanuw?”
Orot iyafutih eo, “Orot wabin te’o Jesu i yur bai matou idadawir naatu na Siloam harew kukufamaim rurubamih iuwu. Imih ayu an arurub, naatu matou to iwa’an anuwanuw.”
Sabuw hibatiy, “Bo iti orot i menamaim ema’am?” Orot iya’afutih eo, “Ayu men aso’ob.”
Nati orot Jesu biyawas hibai hina Pharisee biyah hitit.
Baiyarir ana veya’amaim Jesu nati orot matan fim yuramaim idawir matan igewasin nuw.
Isan imih Pharisee ibanak maiye orot hibatiy mi’itube matan igewasin. Orot hai tur eowen eo, “I yuramaim matou idadawir uwu harewamaim arurub naatu boun i anuwanuw.”
Pharisee afa hi’o, “Iti orot i men Godane na, anayabin Baiyarir ana ofafar i men ekakaif.” Baise afa hi’o, “Bowabow kakafin orot boro mi’itube iti ina’inan tasinaf?” Naatu nati’imaim kouseb matar.
Imih Pharisee hitatabir orot ibanak hibatiy maiye, “Iti orot o mata iwa’an bigewasin isan o boro mi’itube inao?” Orot iya’afutih eo, “I i dinab orot.”
Jew hai ukwarih men kafa’imo hititumatum iti orot matan fim ma’am naatu bounabo matan nuw, naatu orot hinah tamah isah hi’af hina, imaibo hibatiyih.
“Iti orot i kwa natu? Kwa kwa’o’o i matan fim auman tutufuw kekeban iti? Naatu boun i mi’itube enuwanuw?”
Hinah tamah hiyafutih hi’o, “Aki aso’ob iti kek i aki natu, naatu matan fim auman tufuw.
Baise aki men aso’ob, boun i mi’itube enuwanuw, o yait matan iwa’an igewasin, kwaibatiy i sanaman, karam taiyuwin isan boro nao.”
Hinah tamah iti tur hi’o, i Jew sabuw isah hibir, anayabin iti tur i marasika Jew ukwa’ukwarih hi’o hibasit, yait Jesu isan naorereb Keriso nararauw boro kou’ay barene hinabotait ufun nama.
Iti isan imih i hinah tamah hi’o, “Kwa taiyuw kwaibatiy kwa’itin, i sanaman.”
Mar bairu’abin orot matan fim nuwanuw isan hi’af na, naatu hibatiy maiye, “Turobe God nanamaim ai tur ina’owen! Aki aso’ob orot yait o biyawasi i bowabow kakafin wairafin.”
Orot iyafutih eo “Ayu men aso’ob i bowabow kakafin wairafin o en? Ayu sawar ta’imonamo asoso’ob i ayu matou fim ama’am naatu boun i anuw a’i’itah.”
Naatu orot hibatiy, “Abistanawat o isa sinaf? Mi’itube sinaf o mata botawiy?”
Orot iyafutih eo, “Ayu marasika kwa isa aoka naatu kwa men kwanowar. Aisim kwakokok anao maiye kwananowar? Ta’itin kwa auman kwakokok i ana bai’ufununayah kwanamatar?”
Hi’obaibiyab naatu hi’o, “O i nati orot ana bai’ufununayan, baise aki i Moses ana bai’ufununayah.
Aki aso’ob God mutufor Moses hairi hi’o, baise orot nati Jesu tibiwab, aki men kafa’imo aso’ob i menane na?”
Orot matan fim bigewasin iyafutih eo, “Abifofofor men kafaita! I menane nan kwa men kwaso’ob, baise i ayu matu fim iwa’an anuwanuw.
It Taso’ob bowabow kakafih wairafih God hai tur men enonowar. God ana sabuw i ana kok tesisinaf naatu isan tekakakaf i hai tur enonowar.
Men yait ta tafaram wanawanan orot matan fim auman tufuw ma’am matan botawiy nuwanuw ana tur nowaramih.
Iti orot men Godane tanan na’at, i boro men karam iti bowabow tasinaf.”
Iti isan hi’o, “O bowabow kakafin wanawanan itufuw ira’at iyey, i boun aki ini’obaiyi!” Naatu kou’ay barene hibotait tit ufun ma.
Ayubit Ana Fim
Jesu orot hinun tit ufun ma’am ana tur nowar, naatu titita’ur anamaramaim ibatiy, “O Orot Natun kubitumitum?”
Orot Jesu ibatiy, “Regah, iti orot i menatan ku’o anowar saise i anitumitum!”
Jesu orot isan eo, “Orot i iti kwi’i’itin, boun iti airi kwa’o’o.”
Naatu orot eo, “Regah, Ayu abitumatum.” Naatu Jesu nanamaim sun yowen kwafir.
Jesu eo, “Ayu ana iti tafaramaim atitit anayabin i sabuw ana kusibih, saise iyab mata fim boro hinanuw, naatu iyab tenuwanuw boro matah fimabe hinamatar.”
Pharisee afa nati’imaim bairi hima’am iti tur eo’o hinowar, naatu hibatiy, “Nati tur ku’o’o, aki auman matai fim?”
Jesu iyafutih eo, “Kwa mata fim na’at, kwa boro men kakafimih. Baise boun kwa kwa’o’o aki matai anuwanuw, kwa a kakafih i tema’am.”
